name: Q family

products.name: Q3
products.forWho: Travel, places and everyday life: the whole scene.
chooseIf: You photograph moments with context around them
You want macro for close details like food, textures or a watch dial
You like framing tighter in camera at 35, 50, 75 or 90mm

products.name: Q3 43
products.forWho: Mostly people, or anyone who finds 28mm too wide.
chooseIf: Portraits of family, friends and partners are what you love
You want a natural perspective close to how the eye sees
You care about APO color correction and sharpness

products.name: Q3 Monochrom
products.forWho: Black and white devotees and street photographers.
chooseIf: You already see and shoot mostly in black and white
You want the tonal depth of a sensor made only for light and shadow
You like a discreet, all black camera with no red dot
facts: 60MP full frame, Triple Resolution, no color filter
Yes, the first Q with it

pairs.q3|q3-43: Same camera, a different way of seeing. The Q3 takes in the whole scene at 28mm; the Q3 43 sees closer to how your eye does.
pairs.q3|q3-monochrom: Same lens and body. The Q3 records color; the Q3 Monochrom is devoted entirely to black and white.
pairs.q3-43|q3-monochrom: Two different choices at once: the Q3 43 sees at a natural 43mm, in color; the Q3 Monochrom sees wide at 28mm, in black and white only.

question: Are the photos you love wide scenes or closer portraits? Color, or black and white?
demo: Photograph the same person from the same spot with each camera. Show both at full size and let them choose.
